Ordinary triple points have delta 3 and one local additive gluing condition, giving dimension 8 additive and dimension 13 torus. The 13×13 Frobenius involution has a directly checked unimodular basis of six exchanged pairs plus a negative eigenvector (determinant +1), yielding actual torus isomorphisms and rational-point groups; the orbit counts separately certify the two curve zeta functions. No finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The MacLane arrangement is a canonical minimal nonreal eight-line configuration. Its proper singular curve has a natural 21-dimensional connected Picard group with simultaneous additive and toric parts. The integral quadratic descent calculation distinguishes six induced tori and a norm-one torus, refining rational eigenvalue/isogeny information to exact finite abelian group structures; the two zeta functions give complete extension-field counts. Neither the 8-dimensional additive factor nor the integral torus decomposition follows from merely quoting the characteristic polynomial of the arrangement, making this a motivated exact invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
